name: supertranslator
description: Translate public static HTML into a Korean reading edition or local/public text-selectable PDFs into reviewed Korean PDFs, rerender approved translations, or independently compare originals and translations.

interface.shortDescription: Translate, rerender, or independently review HTML/PDF.
interface.longDescription: Web translation delivers a visually checked Korean reading edition by default and retains a source-layout bundle. PDF translation, layout-only rendering of approved translations, and independent original-to-final review remain separate workflows.
defaultPrompt: Translate this public HTML page into a checked Korean reading edition, translate a text-selectable PDF, rerender an approved translation, or independently compare an original and translation.
